description: 'OMP deterministic QA, Jest and Playwright'
applyTo: '**/*.test.ts,**/*.test.tsx,e2e/**/*.ts,firestore-rules/**/*.ts'

Use [OMP quality checks](../skills/omp-quality-checks/SKILL.md) and [Playwright QA](../skills/omp-playwright-qa/SKILL.md). Use Arrange–Act–Assert, synthetic data, independent setup and a specific assertion about behavior. Include denied operations and edge cases where they matter.
